author: BoldAndBrash
body:
We all hate monument blocks, people who jump in our holes, and annoying teammates that walk in front of you as you mine a block.

I believe if we made it so hitting/breaking blocks through teammates would help reduce lots of things such as monument blocking.

opinions?

replies.body: If you're stuck in a hole with someone, it wouldn't help. Otherwise you'd be able to place blocks where teammates are standing, leading to trolls suffocating others in blocks.
